headline: Multiple growth levers from FY28

highlights: Key points  CHALET’s 2QFY27 Consolidated EBITDA came lower than our estimates on account of more than expected dip in MMR occupancy (lower by 667bps YoY).
Overall ARR grew by 11% YoY wherein MMR reported ~14% YoY growth.

The Leisure segment outperformed the Business segment by a large margin wherein Resorts reported ~34% YoY RevPAR growth during 2QFY27.  The management sounded upbeat on 2HFY27 backed by strong demand and also indicated double digit revenue growth in FY28.

ECOD of Varca Goa property has been pushed to FY30.  While quite a few peers are incrementally focusing on capital light growth model, CHALET continues with its strategy of growth via the ownership route with a focus on geographical and category expansion.
valuation: Maintain BUY with a TP of Rs 950 valued at 18x EV/EBITDA for the Hospitality segment on Sep’28E. 2QFY27 performance update: CHALET’s ex-Residential Consolidated revenue growth of ~10.7% YoY was a function of 7.2% RevPAR growth in the Hospitality business and ~22% growth in the Commercial RE segment.
watch: Key points  CHALET’s 2QFY27 Consolidated EBITDA came lower than our estimates on account of more than expected dip in MMR occupancy (lower by 667bps YoY).
